app.name: Aura

validation.birthDateIncomplete: Enter your full date of birth.
validation.birthDateInvalid: That date doesn't look right. Please check it.

password.common: This password is too common. Pick another one.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to your cozy space for two.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password. You'll be signed out on other devices.
reset.done: Your password is updated. Sign in with your new one.
reset.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Open the link from your email again.

notMe.title: Wasn't you?
notMe.body: We'll sign you out everywhere and ask for your password next time.

notMe.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Open the link from your email again.

policyUpdate.title: We've updated our policy

profile.title: Tell us about you
profile.subtitle: Choose how your person will see you.

profile.cityUnavailable: City search isn't available right now. You can add it later in Settings.

timezone.body: This device is in a different zone from your profile ({{current}}).
timezone.failed: Couldn't change your time zone. You can change it later in Settings.

create.title: Invite your person
create.subtitle: Send this code to your person. They enter it in Aura to join you.
create.expired: This invite has expired. Create a new one.
create.shareMessage: Join me on Aura! Invite code: {{code}}
create.linkCopied: Invite link copied — paste it wherever you like to send it.
create.cancelled: Invite cancelled. This code won't work anymore.
create.cooldown: You can start a new pairing after {{date}}. Take a little breather.

enter.title: Enter your invite code
enter.subtitle: Type the code your person sent you, like AURA-7K3M. The last 4 characters are enough.
enter.invalid: Codes look like AURA-7K3M — they never contain 0, O, 1 or I.
enter.scanHint: Hold the invite QR code inside the frame.
enter.scannedInvalid: That QR isn't an Aura invite. Try typing the code instead.
enter.cameraDenied: Without camera access we can't scan the QR. Type the code below, or allow the camera in Settings.

link.title: You're invited to Aura
link.body: Open the Aura app and enter this code. Don't have the app yet? Sign up first.

join.title: Invite
join.joinBody: Once you join and {{name}} confirms, your shared space opens.
join.waitingBody: This screen moves on by itself as soon as {{name}} confirms.
join.requestBody: Confirm and the two of you will be connected in your shared space.
join.notFound: No pending request. The invite may have been cancelled or you're already connected.

startDate.title: Since when have you been together?
startDate.subtitle: Both of you enter the day it all started and confirm.
startDate.label: Start date
startDate.future: The date can't be in the future.
startDate.confirmedBody: You both confirmed it. The counter starts from this day.
startDate.waitingPartner: Your suggestion: {{date}}. Waiting for {{name}} to confirm.
startDate.mismatchBody: You each entered a different day — pick one or edit it.

linked.title: You're connected!
linked.body: Your shared space with {{name}} is ready.

soloShare.title_one: Share the {{count}} item you added earlier with {{name}}?
soloShare.title_other: Share the {{count}} items you added earlier with {{name}}?
soloShare.body: You can move what you added on your own into your shared space. If you say no, it stays just for you under «Private».

waiting.title: Waiting for your person
waiting.noInvite: Invite your person to open your shared space.
waiting.haveCode: Did your person send you an invite?
waiting.soloBody: You can already add memories and plans — once connected, you decide whether to share them.

avatar.preview: Round preview of the new photo

letters.title: Letters

survey.title: One quick question

question.title: Today’s question
question.revealed: You both answered — take a look!
question.partnerAnswered: {{name}} already answered. Answer to see it.

counter.confirmBody: Once you both confirm the day you started, your days together are counted here.

solo.title: Hi, {{name}}!
solo.body: Invite your person — once you are linked, your days, hearts and questions show up here.

thinking.title: Thinking of you
thinking.body: Write one line — or nothing at all, the feeling still arrives.
thinking.label: Your words
thinking.placeholder: e.g. Morning coffee is not the same without you
thinking.cooldown: Take a short breather and send again ({{seconds}} s).

question.title: Today’s question
question.label: Your answer

question.alreadyAnswered: You have already answered this question.
question.soloBody: Daily questions open once you are linked with your person.

places.title: Places list
places.note: The map is coming soon — for now, here are the places you've been, with how many memories each.
places.empty: No memories with a place yet. Add a place when you save your next memory.

recaps.empty: On your anniversary we'll put together a recap of that year's memories for you two.

detail.title: Memory

perspective.title: Two perspectives
perspective.mineEmpty: Write down how you remember this moment.
perspective.placeholder: How do you remember this moment?

comments.title: Comments
comments.empty: Be the first to leave a comment.
comments.label: Write a comment
comments.placeholder: What does this moment bring back?

delete.title: Delete this memory?
delete.body: It stays in the trash for 30 days — you can restore it until then.

conflict.title: This memory was just changed somewhere else
conflict.body: Choose which version to keep — the one you pick is saved.

editor.limits: Up to {{max}} photos and videos per memory. Videos up to 60 seconds and 200 MB. Photos are resized and their location data removed before upload.
editor.uploadFailed: This file didn't upload. Remove it and try adding it again.
editor.sourceMissing: We couldn't find this file. Please choose it again.
editor.someFailed: Some files didn't upload — remove them and save again.
editor.altPlaceholder: For example: The two of us laughing by the lake
editor.needMedia: Add at least one photo or video.

reject.TOO_MANY: {{name}} wasn't added — a memory holds up to {{max}} files.
reject.VIDEO_TOO_LONG: {{name}}: the video is longer than 60 seconds. Pick a shorter clip.
reject.VIDEO_TOO_LARGE: {{name}}: the video is larger than 200 MB.
reject.TYPE: {{name}}: that's not a photo or video.

editor.title: Title
editor.locationHint: If the photo has a location, it fills in by itself. Otherwise enter a place name, latitude and longitude.
editor.locationInvalid: A place needs a name and a valid latitude (−90…90) and longitude (−180…180).
editor.groupsHint: A memory can be in more than one album.
editor.offline: You're offline. What you wrote is saved as a draft — files upload once you're back online.
editor.queued: Your memory will be saved once you're back online.
editor.discardBody: What you wrote and the files you chose will be removed.
editor.draftNote: Even if you leave this page, what you wrote stays in your draft.

search.title: Search
search.author: Added by
search.hint: Type a word or pick a filter and matching memories will show up here.
search.offline: Search needs the internet. Try again once you're online.

groups.title: Albums
groups.deleteBody_one: Only the album is deleted — the {{count}} memory in it stays.
groups.deleteBody_other: Only the album is deleted — the {{count}} memories in it stay.
groups.emptyGroup: No memories in this album yet. Pick it when you add or edit a memory.
groups.offline: Creating an album needs the internet.

trash.title: Trash
trash.note: Deleted memories stay here for 30 days, then they're gone for good.
trash.purgeBody: “{{title}}”, its photos and comments can't be brought back.

export.title: Export
export.pdfNote: A book with a page for each month and every photo with its description.
export.zipNote: An archive of the original photos and videos, named by date and title.
export.noGroups: No albums yet. Create one first.
export.started: We've started. You'll get a notification when it's ready.
export.busy: One export is being prepared. Start the next one when it's done.
export.failedHint: We couldn't prepare it. Try starting it again.
export.offline: Export needs the internet. Try again once you're online.

recap.thanks: Thank you for every day you've made together.

disappearing.body: Once your partner reads a message, it is removed from both phones and the server after the chosen time. Messages already sent are not affected.
disappearing.saved: Saved — applies to your next messages.
disappearing.offline: You can change this once you're back online.
disappearing.protectionNative: Screenshots are blocked on Android. On iPhone, your partner is notified if you take one.
disappearing.protectionWeb: Screenshot protection doesn't work in the web version — browsers can't block or detect screenshots.

promise.title: Shared promise
promise.intro: One small promise for the two of you this week — like “a phone-free evening every Sunday”. Once your partner agrees, it shows at the top of your chat.
promise.label: Promise
promise.waiting: Waiting for your partner to reply.
promise.partnerKept: Your partner said they kept it 💗

chat.heartFailed: Couldn't send the heart. Please try again.

voice.slideToCancel: Slide to cancel · push up to lock
voice.denied: Microphone access is off, so recording isn't possible. Allow it in your phone settings.
voice.unsupported: This browser can't record audio. Try Safari or Chrome.

chat.longPressHint: Long-press to react, reply or edit
chat.quoteA11y: Quote: {{text}}. Tap to jump to the original

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this message?

media.title: Media & files
media.longPressHint: Long-press to see it in the chat

pins.title: Pinned messages
pins.openHint: Tap to see it in the chat

map.subtitle_one: {{count}} place — tap a pin to see its memories
map.subtitle_other: {{count}} places — tap a pin to see their memories

types.title: What to notify you about

types.question: Daily question answered
types.nudges: Gentle nudge after a quiet week

quiet.title: Quiet time
quiet.note: Notifications pause for a while. Your partner only sees “🌙 taking a quiet moment”.

lock.title: Enter your PIN
lock.wait: Too many wrong attempts — please wait a moment.
lock.untilSignOut_one: {{left}} more wrong attempt and you'll need to sign in with your password.
lock.untilSignOut_other: {{left}} more wrong attempts and you'll need to sign in with your password.
lock.biometricFailed: Couldn't recognise you. Please enter your PIN.

settings.title: App lock
settings.note: Aura asks for your PIN (or Face ID / fingerprint) when it opens. The PIN never leaves this device.
settings.mismatch: The PINs didn't match. Please try again.

stats.title: Our numbers
stats.note: Only the two of you see these numbers. Not a score — just memories counted.
stats.badYear: No review found for this year.

devices.title: Active devices
devices.confirmBody: Every session, including this one, will be closed. The fastest protection if your phone is lost.
devices.requirePassword: Require password to sign in again (remote lock)

dataSettings.warning: Storage is over 80% full. You can delete files you no longer need or empty the trash.

dataSettings.exportBusy: A copy is already being prepared. Try again once it finishes.
dataSettings.trashNote: Deleted memories are kept for 30 days.
